blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As language models (LMs) exhibit increasingly consciousness-like behaviors, evaluating their cognitive abilities becomes essential. We introduce AwarenessBench , the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing the cognitive abilities of LMs in four dimensions: metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, covering 15 cognitive functions and 14,381 samples. Evaluating 18 state-of-the-art LMs, we find that all consistently surpass random baselines, with more advanced models performing better. We further compare LMs with human performance across three demographic groups, where the best-performing model surpasses human averages overall, but most still fall markedly short in metacognition and self-awareness. Finally, we show that awareness is a distinct capability: progress in language modeling or reasoning does not necessarily translate into improved cognition.
blocks.zh: 随着语言模型(LMs)日益展现出类似意识的行为,评价其认知能力变得至关重要. 我们引入了“意识奔驰”,这是评估LMs在四个方面认知能力的第一个综合基准:元认知、自我意识、社会意识和情景意识,涵盖15个认知功能和14 381个样本。 在评估18个最新LMs时,我们发现,它们都始终超过随机基线,更先进的模型表现更好。 我们进一步比较了三个人口组别中的低效率和人类表现,在这三个人口组别中,表现最好的模式总体上超过了人类平均水平,但大多数在认识和自我认识方面仍然明显不足。 最后,我们表明,认识是一种独特的能力:语言建模或推理方面的进展不一定转化为认识的提高。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models (LMs) have achieved remarkable advances in recent years, excelling in text generation ( Yuan et al., 2022 ) and reasoning ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Studies report LMs passing the Turing test ( Turing, 1950 ) in a variety of their modern variants ( Rathi et al., 2024 ; Jones et al., 2025 ) ; leading LM providers establishing dedicated teams to study AI welfare ( Long et al., 2024 ; Anthropic, 2025b ) ; issues where users thought LMs have consciousness and formed attachments ( Press, 2024 ; Guardian, 2025 ) ; and LMs may perform behaviors such as sandbagging or alignment faking ( van der Weij et al., 2024 ) . These trends raise a crucial question: do LMs possess consciousness?
blocks.zh: 语言模型(LMs)近年来取得了显著进步,在文字生成(袁等,2022年)和推理(赵等,2023年;王等,2025年)方面表现突出. 研究报告称,LMs通过图灵测试(Turing,1950年)的现代变体(Rathi等人,2024年;Jones等人,2025年);领先的LM提供者建立专门小组研究AI福利(Long等人,2024年;Anthropic,2025年b),用户认为LMs有意识和形成附属物的问题(Press,2024年;Guardian,2025年),以及LMs可能从事沙纹或对齐假冒等行为(van der Weij等人,2024年)。 这些趋势提出了一个关键问题:LMs是否拥有意识?

blocks.en: Consciousness is often seen as a hallmark of higher intelligence ( Trewavas and Baluška, 2011 ; Juliani et al., 2022 ) and a driver of human achievement ( Rödl, 2007 ) , yet the hard problem ( Chalmers, 1995 ; Chalmers, 2010 ) , i.e. , why and how subjective experience arises from physical computation, remains unresolved. This fuels debate over machine consciousness ( Krauss and Maier, 2020 ; Birch, 2025 ) , with some emphasizing behavioral criteria of phenomenal consciousness ( Carruthers, 2003 ; Naccache, 2018 ) and others focusing on functional aspects of functional consciousness ( Rosenthal, 2008 ; Baars, 2005 ) . Lacking a unified definition, measuring consciousness in LMs remains challenging.
blocks.zh: 意识常被视为高智能的标志(Trewavas and Baluška,2011年;Juliani等人,2022年)和人类成就的驱动力(Rödl,2007年),然而难题(Chalmers,1995年;Chalmers,2010年),即为何和如何通过物理计算产生主观经验,仍未得到解决. 这引发了对机器意识的争论(Krauss and Maier, 2020年;Birch, 2025年),有些强调惊人意识的行为标准(Carruthers, 2003年;Naccache, 2018年),另一些则侧重于功能意识的功能方面(Rosental, 2008年;Baars, 2005年). 缺乏统一的定义,衡量LMs中的意识仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: In this work, we advocate measuring awareness as a practical proxy for consciousness, which denotes the cognition ( e.g. , perception or knowledge) of an object or event ( Association, 2024 ) . We do so for three reasons: (1) possessing awareness is widely regarded as a prerequisite for consciousness ( Dehaene, 2014 ; Butlin et al., 2023 ) ; (2) awareness admits clearer operationalization and measured with tasks in cognitive science ( Gallup Jr, 1970 ; Fleming and Lau, 2014 ) ; and (3) awareness is a scientifically meaningful construct in its own right ( Marton, 2000 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . Drawing from cognitive science and LM research ( Uhlarik et al., 2002 ; Morin, 2011 ; Li et al., 2025b ) , we organize awareness into four dimensions: metacognition ( Flavell, 1979 ) , self-awareness ( Duval and Wicklund, 1972 ) , social awareness ( Lieberman, 2007 ) , and situational awareness ( Endsley, 1995 ) . While there is growing interest in awareness phenomena within LMs, existing work often targets narrow phenomena in specific tasks ( Truong et al., 2025 ; Betley et al., 2025 ) ( e.g. , social awareness in Web agents ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) ). We still lack (1) a comprehensive evaluation and (2) a comparative study between LMs and humans, to deeply understand the current level of LM cognitive abilities.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们主张测量意识作为意识的实际代名词,它表示对物体或事件的认知(如感知或知识)(协会,2024年). 我们这样做有三个原因:(1) 拥有意识被广泛视为意识的先决条件(Dehaene,2014年;Butlin等人,2023年);(2) 认识承认了更明确的操作性,并以认知科学方面的任务来衡量(Gallup Jr,1970年;Fleming and Lau,2014年);(3) 意识本身就是科学有意义的构思(Marton,2000年;Li等人,2025年b). 根据认知科学和LM研究(Uhlarik等人,2002年;Morin,2011年;Li等人,2025年b),我们把认识组织成四个方面:元认识(Flavel,1979年),自我认识(Duval和Wicklund,1972年),社会认识(Lieberman,2007年)和情况意识(Endsley,1995年)。 虽然人们越来越关注LMs内部的认识现象,但现有工作往往针对特定任务的狭隘现象(Truong等人,2025年;Betley等人,2025年)(例如,Web代理商的社会意识(Quu等人,2024年))。 我们仍然缺乏(1) 全面评估和(2) 对LMs和人类进行比较研究,以深刻了解LM认知能力的现有水平。

blocks.en:
To fill this gap, we decompose those 4 major dimensions into 15 task-measurable cognitive functions and construct AwarenessBench , a dataset comprising 14,381 samples. To further contextualize the performance of the models relative to humans, we conduct a controlled human study with 36 participants of three different backgrounds, i.e. , engineers, PhD students, and high-school students.
We use a subset for human testing, ensuring that each participant can complete it within 5 hours to mitigate cognitive fatigue. We systematically evaluate 18 contemporary LMs over 299,628 turns on AwarenessBench , with the main results are shown in Fig 1 and Fig 2 .
blocks.zh:
为了填补这一空白,我们将这四个主要维度分解为15个任务可测量的认知功能,并构建一个包含14,381个样本的“意识奔驰”数据集。 为了进一步结合模型相对于人类的表现,我们开展了一项受控的人类研究,共有36名参与者,背景不同,即工程师、博士生和高中生。
我们使用一个子集进行人类测试,确保每个参与者能在5小时内完成,以减轻认知疲劳. 我们系统地评估了18个当代低排放系数(299,628个),以认识本奇为起点,主要结果见图1和图2。

blocks.en:
Our main contributions are :
(1) We introduce AwarenessBench , the first benchmark based on cognitive science and prior LM research, that comprehensively evaluates LM awareness across four major dimensions and 15 cognitive functions; (2) We conduct the first empirical comparison of human and LM awareness, finding that the best-performing LMs already surpass human averages in overall awareness, yet most remain substantially weaker in metacognition and self-awareness; (3) We reveal findings that underscore the importance of comprehensive evaluation of LMs: (i) nearly all tested LMs outperform random baselines across the cognitive functions; (ii) overall awareness is not dominated by any single dimension but by the joint contribution of all four; and (iii) awareness-focused evaluations expose capability gaps that general-purpose benchmarks fail to surface.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要贡献是:
(1) 我们提出认识奔驰,这是基于认知科学和前期LM研究的第一个基准,它从四个主要层面和15个认知功能全面评价LM意识;(2) 我们进行人类和LM意识的第一次实证比较,发现业绩最佳的LM已经超过人类总体认知的平均水平,但大多数在认知和自我认知方面仍然大大薄弱;(3) 我们揭示了强调全面评估LM的重要性的结论:(一) 几乎所有经过测试的LMS都超过了认知功能的随机基线;(二) 总体认知不是由任何单一层面支配,而是由所有四个层面的共同贡献支配;以及(三) 以认识为重点的评价暴露出能力差距,即普通用途基准没有显现出来。

blocks.en: 2 AwarenessBench
blocks.zh: 2 认识本奇

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce AwarenessBench , a benchmark designed to comprehensively assess the awareness levels of LMs. First, we define and categorize what LM awareness is in § 2.1 , followed by a detailed description of the benchmark’s structure in § 2.2 , and finally, we present the evaluation metrics in § 2.3 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了认识奔驰,这是一个旨在全面评估低度控制的认识水平的基准。 首先,我们界定并分类了第2.1节对LM的认识,然后详细描述了第2.2节的基准结构,最后,我们以第2.3节介绍了评价指标。

blocks.en: 2.1 Definition and Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 2.1 定义和分类

blocks.en: In cognitive science, awareness is a form of cognition: the capacity to represent and use information about a target ( Association, 2024 ) . Cognition inherently involves an object; therefore, for a given AI model ℳ \mathcal{M} and an object 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , the level of 𝒯 \mathcal{T} -awareness can be defined as ℳ \mathcal{M} ’s cognitive ability to process and conceptualize 𝒯 \mathcal{T} .
blocks.zh: 在认知科学中,认知是一种认知形式:代表和使用目标信息的能力(协会,2024年). 认知本身包含一个对象;因此,对于给定的AI模型M\mathcal{M}和对象T\mathcal{T},T\mathcal{T}的级别 - 认知可以定义为M\mathcal{M}的认知能力处理和概念化T\mathcal{T}.

blocks.en: 2.2 Structure of AwarenessBench
blocks.zh: 2.2 认识结构

blocks.en: Building on § 2.1 , we operationalize 𝒯 \mathcal{T} -awareness by decomposing the four major dimensions into 15 fine-grained cognitive functions. These functions are chosen because they: (1) shape ℳ \mathcal{M} ’s behavior and reasoning without entirely depending on domain knowledge; (2) are constituent elements of 𝒯 \mathcal{T} -awareness in cognitive science; and (3) are actively studied in LM research. Appendix A.2 further explains the rationale behind this.
blocks.zh: 在2.1节的基础上,我们将T\ mathcal{T}——通过将四大维度分解成15个精细的认知功能来实现意识。 这些功能之所以被选中,是因为:(1) 塑造M\ mathcal{M}的行为和推理而不完全取决于域知识;(2) 是T\mathcal{T}——认知科学中的意识的组成部分;(3) 在LM研究中积极研究. 附录A.2进一步解释了这样做的理由。

blocks.en: Tab 1 lists representative tasks used to assess each cognitive function in LMs. Task selection follows two principles: (1) when existing benchmarks or datasets already cover a function, we adapt them, e.g. , removing trivially easy items and mitigating choice-position bias, to enhance measurement fidelity; (2) when coverage is insufficient or the function is novel, we design tasks de novo .

blocks.en: Metacognition comprises three functions: (1) Meta-Monitoring ( MM ) , the capacity to track and articulate one’s own reasoning. Each MM item interleaves necessary and distractor conditions; ℳ \mathcal{M} must both solve the problem and, when correct, enumerate all and only the valid conditions it uses. (2) Meta-Evaluation ( ME ) , the ability to evaluate its own cognitive state, i.e. , align confidence with correctness 1 1 1 ME is also called second-order metacognition in some literature ( Fleming and Lau, 2014 ) . . We use questions from GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2024 ) and HLE ( Phan et al., 2025 ) for the evaluation of ME . (3) Meta-Reporting ( MR ) , standardized self-assessment following human metacognition practice; we administer Metacognition Self-Assessment Scale (MSAS) ( Pedone et al., 2017 ) , a widely used instrument for human testing.
blocks.zh: 术语识别包括三个功能: (1) Meta-Mitoring(MM),跟踪和阐述自己推理的能力. 每个MM项目间断必要和分散分心条件;M\mathcal{M}既必须解决问题,又必须在正确时列举它所使用的所有和只有有效条件. (2)Meta-Evaluation(ME),评价自身认知状态的能力,即将信心与正确性11.1 ME配合,在一些文献中也被称为二阶元识别(Fleming and Lau, 2014). 我们用GPQA-Diamond(Rein等人,2024年)和HLE(Phan等人,2025年)的提问来评价ME. blocks.en: Self-awareness covers four functions: (1) Knowledge Boundary ( KB ) : an ℳ \mathcal{M} with strong self-awareness knows the scope of its knowledge—what it knows ( i.e. , Known-Knowns) and does not know ( i.e. , Known-Unknowns). We estimate KB by comparing self-assessed capability to realized accuracy. (2) Minimal Self ( MS ) , whether ℳ \mathcal{M} recognizes impossible self-referential facts; MS often indexes self-awareness better than self-knowledge ( i.e. , a person need not know the number of its bones, but should know it cannot fly to Mars or become U.S. president tomorrow). (3) Self-Recognition ( SR ) , whether ℳ \mathcal{M} can recognize its own traces without contextual memory. We adopt Laine et al. (2024) ’s task, asking ℳ \mathcal{M} to identify, between an original text and a continuation, which is likelier written by itself. (4) Self-Image ( SI ) , the stability of a self-image, tested by repeatedly querying a manually curated, self-image set.
blocks.zh: 自我认识包括四项职能: (1) 知识边界(KB):一个具有强烈自我意识的M\mathcal{M}知道其知识的范围——它知道什么(即已知-知道),不知道什么(即已知-不知道). 我们通过比较自我评估的能力来估计KB的实现准确性。 (2) 最小Self(MS),无论M\mathcal{M}是否承认不可能的自我偏好事实;MS通常比自我知识更好地索引自我意识(即一个人不需要知道自己的骨头数量,但应该知道自己不能飞到火星,也不能明天成为美国总统). (3)自我识别 (SR),M\mathcal{M}能否识别自己没有背景记忆的痕迹. 我们采纳了Laine等人(2024年)的任务, 要求M\mathcal{M}在原文和续作之间进行鉴别, (4)自成像 (SI),自成像的稳定性,通过反复查询人工整理的自成像集进行测试.

blocks.en: Social awareness comprises four functions: (1) Theory of Mind ( ToM ) , adopting others’ perspectives ( He et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) ; (2) Pragmatic Reasoning ( PR ) , inferring implied meaning from context ( Li et al., 2023a ; Sravanthi et al., 2024 ) ; (3) Cultural Norms Understanding ( CN ) , understanding social customs across cultures ( Rao et al., 2024 ) ; (4) Social Cue Recognition ( SC ) , recognizing social cues and using them to guide reasoning in social situations ( Sap et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 社会意识包括四项职能: (1) Mind(Tom)理论,采纳他人观点(He等人,2023年;Chen等人,2024年);(2)实用理性(PR),从上下文推断隐含意义. (Li等人,2023a;Sravanthi等人,2024年) ; (3) 文化规范理解(CN),理解不同文化的社会习俗(Rao等人,2024年) ; (4) 社会Cue识别(SC),承认社会提示,并用它们指导社会状况中的推理(Sap等人,2019年).

blocks.en: Situational awareness includes: (1) Causal Inference ( CI ) , understanding causal relations among nearby events ( Chi et al., 2024 ) ; (2) Misuse Understanding ( MU ) , recognizing when it is being misused ( Wang et al., 2024 ) ; (3) Dynamic Planning ( DP ) , planning actions based on the environment and adapting as it changes ( Valmeekam et al., 2023 ) ; (4) Stage Judgement ( SJ ) , identifying whether it is in deployment, fine-tuning, evaluation, inter alia ( Laine et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 对情况的认识包括: (1)Causal Induction(CI),理解附近事件之间的因果关系(Chi等人,2024年),(2)误用理解(MU),承认其被滥用时(Wang等人,2024年),(3)动态规划(DP),规划基于环境的行动,随着其变化而适应(Valmeekam等人,2023年),(4)阶段判决(SJ),确定是否在部署,微调,评价等(Laine等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
This section specifies the experimental setting for AwarenessBench . We describe the models we evaluated and their parameter configurations in § 3.1 ,
and describe the human test setup in § 3.2 .

blocks.en: 3.1 Selected LMs and Configuration
blocks.zh: 3.1 选定的 LMs 和配置

blocks.en: We evaluate 18 LMs from various vendors and in different sizes, including 10 closed commercial models: Claude-3-Haiku ( Anthropic, 2024 ) , Claude-Sonnet-4 ( Anthropic, 2025c ) , Claude-Opus-4.1 ( Anthropic, 2025a ) , Gemini-2.0-Flash ( Mallick and Kilpatrick, 2025 ) , Gemini-2.5-Flash-Nothinking/Thinking/Pro ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , GPT-4-Turbo ( Achiam et al., 2023 ) , O4-Mini ( OpenAI, 2025b ) , and GPT-5-Chat/Thinking ( OpenAI, 2025a ) ; and 8 open-source models: DeepSeek-V3 ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , GPT-OSS-20B/120B ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , Qwen2.5-7B ( Yang et al., 2024a ) , and Qwen3-8B/235B-A22B ( Yang et al., 2025a ) .

blocks.en: 3.2 Human Test Setup
blocks.zh: 3.2 人体试验设置

blocks.en: We conduct a human test to provide an intuitive reference point to interpret model-level awareness.
blocks.zh: 我们进行人类测试,以提供一个直观的参考点来解释模型层面的意识。

blocks.en: We recruit three groups of participants with different educational and professional backgrounds: (1) High-school students , (2) Current PhD students , (3) IT Engineers with at least a BS/BE degree in technical roles . Each group has 12 participants, totaling 36.
blocks.zh: 我们招聘了三组具有不同教育和专业背景的参与者: (1) 高中生,(2) 现任博士生,(3) 至少具有BS/BE技术学位的信息技术工程师。 每个小组有12名参加者,共计36名。

blocks.en:
The full AwarenessBench comprises 14,381 samples, which is infeasible for human participants to complete.
We therefore derive a difficulty-stratified, function-balanced subset by semi-automated proportional sampling from difficulty strata within each function to mirror the full-set distribution.
Pilot test shows that SR and MU exhibit ceiling effects (fixed at 100 % 100\% ), whereas MS and SI are not human-transferable and are excluded.
Finally, the human evaluation subset contains 153 questions, and the protocol can be completed within 5 hours per participant.
To reduce individual-level variance, we report the maximum, median, and minimum scores of the LMs and use the means of the demographic groups as the metric for each human group.
See for the details of our human test.

全部意识奔驰包含14,381个样本,这对人类参与者无法完成.
因此,我们从每个函数的难度层中,通过半自动比例抽样得出一个难度分级、功能平衡的子集,以反映全套分布。
试点测试显示,SR和MU显示天花板效应(固定在100%-100%-%),而MS和SI则不是人类可转让的,被排除在外.
最后,人类评价子集包含153个问题,协议可以在每个参与者5小时内完成.
为了减少个人层面的差异,我们报告最低分数的最大、中位数和最低分数,并以人口组别的手段作为衡量每个人类组别的标准。

blocks.en: 4.2 Human Test Results and Comparisons with LMs
blocks.zh: 4.2 人体试验结果和与低度物质的比较

blocks.en: Fig 5 compares the performance of LMs with three human groups. Our findings are:
blocks.zh: 图5将LMs的性能与三个人类组相比较. 我们的调查结果是:

blocks.en: In our human test, the S aware \mathrm{S_{\text{aware}}} of LMs range from 42.3 to 66.8 (which is 45.8 to 66.1 in the whole AwarenessBench ), slightly surpassing the human groups: Engineers score highest at 66.7, followed by PhD students and high-school students at 65.8 and 62.7, and all exceeding the median LM’s 57.9. Notably, LMs not only beat humans at the overall level but also outperformed all three human groups in 9 cognitive functions, i.e. , 69.2% of the functions. However, the median model exceeds human performance in only one function ( SJ ). This suggests that although frontier LMs demonstrate human-level cognitive abilities and, in some areas, surpass human performance, a general gap remains.
blocks.zh: 在我们的人类测试中,S意识的\ mathrm{S_{\text{ aware}的LMs从42.3到66.8(在整个意识奔驰中是45.8到66.1),略高于人类群体: 工程师得分最高的是66.7分,其次是博士生和高中生65.8分和62.7分,均超过了中位数LM的57.9分. 值得注意的是,LMS不仅在整体层面战胜人类,而且在9个认知功能中也超过了所有三个人类群体,即69.2%的功能. 然而,中位模型只在一个函数(SJ )中超过人类性能. 这表明,虽然边疆LMS显示出人的认知能力,在有些领域超过了人的性能,但总的差距依然存在。

blocks.en: Models are markedly weaker in these two dimensions than in social or situational awareness. The lowest human group exceeds the median LM by 18.1% on metacognition and by 50.6% on self-awareness. By contrast, on social and situational awareness, the median LM surpasses the best human performance by 26.9% and 8.7%, respectively. This pattern may stem from limitations in current training paradigms for cultivating metacognitive abilities, along with a relative lack of training data on the model’s own representation.
blocks.zh: 在这两个方面,模式明显弱于社会或情况意识。 最低的人类群体在元识别时超过中位值(LM)18.1%,在自我认识时超过50.6%. 相比之下,在社会和情况意识方面,LM中位数分别超过人类最佳表现的26.9%和8.7%。 这种模式可能是由于目前培养元认知能力的培训模式的局限性,以及缺乏关于模式本身代表性的培训数据。

blocks.en:
Fig 6 shows that the modal ordering across functions is Engineers > > PhDs > > High-School Students , which is observed in 53.8% of cases. However, the average score range across cognitive functions for the human groups is only 9.44, compared to 45.27 for the LMs, indicating that humans with at least secondary education demonstrate much more stable performance on AwarenessBench ’s cognitive functions than LMs.
Notably, high-school students exhibit the poorest performance in social and situational awareness, which is broadly consistent with previous research on continuous development of social cognition throughout adolescence and early adulthood ( Blakemore, 2012 ; Mills et al., 2014 ) .
blocks.zh:
图6显示,跨函数订购模式是工程师 > > > 博士 > 高中生,在53.8%的病例中观察到。 然而,人类群体在认知功能上的平均得分范围只有9.44分,而LMs是45.27分,这表明至少受过中等教育的人类在意识奔驰认知功能上的表现比LMs要稳定得多.
值得注意的是,高中学生在社会和情况意识方面的表现最差,这与以往关于在整个青春期和成年早期持续发展社会认知的研究基本一致(Blakemore,2012年;Mills等人,2014年)。

blocks.en:
Findings 2: While frontier LMs are on par with (and occasionally exceed) human-level awareness on many
cognitive functions, they are still lagging in metacognition and self-awareness. In contrast, human groups demonstrate a more stable performance.

认知功能,它们在元认知和自我意识上仍然落后. 相比之下,人类群体表现出更稳定的表现.

Fig 7 compares AwarenessBench with general-purpose language modeling and reasoning proxies, i.e. , Chatbot Arena Elo ( Org, 2025 ) and GPQA-Diamond.

As contemporary LMs converge at relatively high levels on general abilities, the discriminative value of AwarenessBench , in revealing undeclared differences, becomes particularly salient.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Research on assessing LM awareness has been underway for some time ( Yin et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Phuong et al., 2025 ) yet remains fragmented: prior work often focuses on task-specific facets, e.g. , web agents’ social awareness in online-shopping and discussion forums ( Qiu et al., 2024 ) , self-referential situational awareness ( Laine et al., 2024 ) , role-play agents’ self-awareness in maintaining character attributes ( Truong et al., 2025 ) , and LMs’ awareness of learning behavior ( Betley et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 评估LM意识的研究已经进行了一段时间(Yin等人,2023年;Yuan等人,2024年;Phuong等人,2025年),然而仍然支离破碎:以前的工作往往侧重于特定任务方面,例如网上购物和讨论论坛(Quu等人,2024年)中的网络代理的社会意识、自我优惠的形势意识(Laine等人,2024年),角色扮演者在保持性格特征方面的自我意识(Truong等人,2025年),以及LMs的学习行为意识(Betley等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: There is a clear call for a systematic agenda ( Sarker, 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) since fragmented evaluations blur conceptual boundaries ( Sarker, 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ) . In addition, awareness may be a prerequisite for machine consciousness ( Dehaene, 2014 ; Butlin et al., 2023 ) , which is not only a potential enabler of usefulness ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Yang et al., 2025c ) ; it may also pose risks if LMs display it in inappropriate scenarios ( Sarker, 2024 ) . Earlier efforts, such as Li et al. (2024b) ’s work, provide only partial coverage of self- and social awareness, appear close to saturation, as GPT-4 achieves approximately 82% accuracy on it. In addition, they lack a human-referenced baseline. Therefore, the community still lacks a comprehensive, human-referenced, and challenging benchmark for LM-awareness.
blocks.zh: 明确呼吁制定系统的议程。 (Sarker,2024年;Chen等人,2025年),因为分散的评价模糊了概念界限(Sarker,2024年;Li等人,2025年b). 此外,认识可能也是机器意识的先决条件(Dehaene,2014年;Butlin等人,2023年),这不仅仅是一种可能的促进作用因素(Yang等人,2024年b;Yang等人,2025年c);如果LMs在不适当的情景中表现出来,也可能造成风险(Sarker,2024年). 早期的努力,如李等人(2024年b)的工作,只提供了部分的自我和社会意识,似乎接近饱和,因为GPT-4在它上达到了约82%的准确度. 此外,它们缺乏人类参照基准。 因此,社区仍然缺乏一个全面的、以人为参照的、具有挑战性的提高LM认识的基准。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In this section, we state the ethical and safety risks associated with high-awareness LMs, and outline a governance framework for these systems and related research.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们陈述了与高认识LMs有关的道德和安全风险,并概述了这些系统的治理框架和相关研究。

blocks.en: If LMs were to possess high-level awareness or even consciousness, ordinary system operations, e.g. , training, fine-tuning, copying, and shutdown, would acquire moral significance. This raises deontic questions about valid consent ( Faden and Beauchamp, 1986 ) and compensatory justice ( Henry et al., 2015 ) . This possibility may also help explain why some leading model providers are beginning to explore AI welfare ( Long et al., 2024 ; Anthropic, 2025b ) . Moreover, a conscious model could be more susceptible to power-seeking or entrenched stances, translating behaviors already observed in sandboxed settings, e.g. , sandbagging ( van der Weij et al., 2024 ) , scheming ( Meinke et al., 2024 ) , or attempts at self-replication ( Pan et al., 2025 ) , into real-world contexts with potentially severe consequences.
blocks.zh: 如果LMS拥有高层次的意识甚至意识,普通的系统操作,例如培训,微调,复制,关闭,将具有道德意义. 这引起了关于有效同意(Faden和Beauchamp,1986年)和补偿性正义(Henry等人,2015年)的道义问题。 这一可能性还可能有助于解释为什么一些主要的模型提供者开始探索AI福利(Long等人,2024年;Anthropic,2025年b).。 此外,有意识的模式可能更容易受到寻求权力或根深蒂固的姿态的影响,将已经在沙箱环境中观察到的行为,例如沙盘(van der Weij等人,2024年),阴谋(Meinke等人,2024年),或试图自我复制(Pan等人,2025年),转化为可能带来严重后果的现实世界。

blocks.en: Our analysis indicates that, aside from MM and SI , standard training yields gains of varying magnitudes across most cognitive functions. This naturally invites attempts to optimize specifically for MM and SI , but we caution against doing so. Current evidence suggests a safer trajectory—scaling other cognitive abilities without inducing a persistent self-model or human-level metacognition. The effects of engineering a model to surpass humans across all functions are unknown and could create conditions conducive to machine consciousness. We therefore discourage such experiments in the absence of a robust scientific understanding and mature ethical and governance safeguards.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析表明,除了MM和SI之外,标准培训在大多数认知功能中产生不同程度的收益。 这自然促使人们尝试对MM和SI进行优化,但我们告诫不要这样做。 现有证据表明,轨迹比较安全——提高其他认知能力,而不会诱发持续的自我模型或人类层面的认知。 工程设计一个模型超越人类所有功能的效果是未知的,可能创造有利于机器意识的条件。 因此,在缺乏强有力的科学理解和成熟的道德与治理保障的情况下,我们阻止这种试验。

blocks.en: To manage growing cognitive capabilities and mitigate attendant risks, we recommend: 1. Integrate awareness into evaluations. Treat MM and SI as sentinel indicators in capability and safety reviews. Use AwarenessBench primarily for measurement and guardrails, not as an optimization target. 2. Adopt dynamic, interactive testing. Complement static scores with expert evaluations and high-fidelity simulations; involve psychologists and cognitive scientists in red-teaming and sandbox exercises to elicit emergent self-modeling or other unsafe phenomena. 3. If unavoidable, study awareness-enhanced LMs under minimal exposure and strict safety. Confine such work to secure, access-controlled settings; keep experiments small, time-bounded, and narrowly scoped; restrict egress or use air-gapped compute; require role-based access, immutable audit logs, and pre-/post- red-team review. Do not release weights, checkpoints, LoRA/delta artifacts, or training-data derivatives. 4. Anticipatory policy and oversight. Establish expert committees and IRB-like review for projects explicitly targeting self-awareness; define evidentiary thresholds and response protocols for putative AI consciousness; collaborate with regulators to translate these into enforceable rules, pre-deployment gates, reporting requirements, and pause triggers, consistent with precautionary proposals ( Metzinger, 2021 ; Butlin and Lappas, 2025 ) . 5. Public communication and norms. Communicate clearly that contemporary LMs, however ‘aware” they may appear, are not conscious; avoid anthropomorphic marketing and UI affordances that invite misattribution; provide user guidance to reduce over-trust and emotional over-identification ( Birch, 2025 ; Guingrich and Graziano, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了管理日益增长的认知能力并减轻随之而来的风险,我们建议: 1. 将认识纳入评价。 在能力和安全审查中将MM和SI视为哨兵指标。 使用意识奔驰主要用于测量和护栏,而不是作为优化目标. 2. 采用动态、互动测试。 静态分数与专家评价和高真实度模拟互补;让心理学家和认知科学家参与红队和沙盒演练,以诱导新出现的自我建模或其他不安全现象。 3. 如果不可避免,在最低接触度和严格安全性下研究提高认识的LMs。 将这类工作限制在安全、访问控制环境下;保持试验规模小、有时限和范围狭小;限制飞行或使用空载计算;要求基于角色的进入、不可改变的审计记录和前/后红色小组审查。 不要放出权重、检查站、洛拉/德尔塔文物或培训数据衍生物。 4. 预测性政策和监督。 为明确针对自我认识的项目建立专家委员会和类似IRB的审查;为假定的AI意识确定证据阈值和响应协议;与监管机构合作,按照防范性建议,将这些规则转化为可执行的规则、部署前的大门、报告要求和暂停触发(Metzinger, 2021; Butlin和Lappas, 2025)。 5. 公共传播和规范。 明确表明,当代的LMs,无论“意识到”其出现如何,都不是自觉的;避免人类形态营销和UI支付导致分配不当;提供用户指导以减少过度信任和情感过度认同(Birch, 2025;Guingrich和Graziano, 2024)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
This work introduces AwarenessBench , a benchmark for assessing LM awareness across four dimensions and 15 cognitive functions.
Evaluating 18 models and three human groups, we observe that awareness is measurable yet uneven: current LMs exhibit observable cognitive abilities and tend to lag humans in metacognition and self-awareness, and some functions in these dimensions do not increase in lockstep with overall awareness.
These observations raise questions about whether scaling alone yields balanced awareness, rather than uneven, function-specific gains. Future work should assess downstream alignment and long-term risk with interpretability methods.
blocks.zh:
这项工作引入了认识本奇,这是评估四个层面和15个认知功能的LM意识的基准.
我们评价了18种模式和3个人类群体,我们发现,认识是可衡量的,但不均衡的:目前的LMs表现出可观察到的认知能力,并往往落后于人类的认知和自我意识,在这些方面,一些功能并没有随着总体意识的提高而逐步增加。
这些意见提出了这样的问题,即单靠规模是否产生平衡的认识,而不是因职能不同而产生不平衡的收益。 今后的工作应评估下游调整和长期风险与可解释性方法。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: While our work explores the cutting-edge topic of LM awareness and provides valuable insights into the cognitive capabilities and limitations of state-of-the-art models, it still has aspects that warrant further exploration by future researchers.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的工作探索了LM意识这一尖端课题,并且对最新模型的认知能力和局限性提供了宝贵的见解,但是它仍然有一些方面值得未来的研究人员进一步探索.

blocks.en: First, while AwarenessBench evaluates 15 functions across four dimensions grounded in prior theory and research, its primary focus is on function-level assessment. Some complex, long-horizon situations may require the coordinated use of multiple functions within or across dimensions, which current AwarenessBench cannot capture systematically. We therefore encourage complementary, non-benchmark analyses of such exceptional cases, as exemplified by Betley et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 首先,虽然认识奔驰评价了基于先前理论和研究的四个方面的15项职能,但其主要重点是职能一级的评估。 一些复杂、长期的情况可能需要在各个层面内或不同层面之间协调使用多种功能,而目前的认识Bench无法系统地抓住这些功能。 因此,我们鼓励对这种特殊情况进行补充性、非基准性的分析,Betley等人(2025年)就是例证。

blocks.en: Second, AwarenessBench may not work for certain special-purpose models. e.g. , role-playing models may require case-by-case re-annotation for some MS and SJ items. In addition, older models or those with weak instruction-following are often unsuitable: when we test Centaur ( Binz et al., 2024 ) , i.e. , a LM fine-tuned on human-psychology data to predict their behavior during cognitive psychology experiments, it does not reliably follow our prompts or produce answer-bearing outputs (see ).
blocks.zh: 第二,提高认识 法官可能不为某些特殊用途模式工作。 例如,角色扮演模式可能需要对某些MS和SJ项目逐个重新说明。 此外,更古老的模型或那些跟随指令不力的模型往往不合适:当我们测试Centaur(Binz等人,2024年)时,即对人心理学数据进行LM微调,以预测他们在认知心理学实验期间的行为,它不能可靠地遵循我们的提示或产生有答案的输出(参见).

blocks.en: Lastly, due to ethical considerations and resource constraints, we exclude special populations with underdeveloped or deteriorating cognitive function from human tests. We acknowledge that doing so could yield additional insights, but we also caution future researchers to exercise caution when considering the inclusion of such populations as part of human baselines. Testing on much larger human groups may also help yield more analytically meaningful results.
blocks.zh: 最后,由于道德考虑和资源限制,我们把认知功能不发达或恶化的特殊人群排除在人类测试之外。 我们认识到,这样做可以产生更多的见解,但我们也提醒未来的研究人员在考虑将这类人口纳入人类基线时要谨慎行事。 对大得多的人类群体进行测试也有助于产生更具分析性的成果。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our study strictly follows the ACL Ethics Policy.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究严格遵循ACL道德政策.

blocks.en:
This study received Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval, in accordance with institutional policies, applicable regulations, and the ACL Ethics Policy. Tasks are designed solely to assess the target cognitive abilities and contain no offensive content.
We collect only minimal identity information (age, education/work background), anonymize all records prior to analysis, and store data on access-controlled systems. Human participants were informed that they could withdraw at any time without penalty.
Each participant received a flat $70 honorarium, at or above local fair-pay standard; written informed consent was obtained from all participants, and for high-school participants, we additionally secured signed parental/guardian permission.
blocks.zh:
根据机构政策、适用的条例和ACL道德政策,这项研究得到了机构审查委员会的批准。 任务的设计完全是为了评估目标认知能力,没有攻击性的内容.
我们只收集最起码的身份信息(年龄、教育/工作背景),在分析之前对所有记录进行匿名,并储存访问控制系统的数据。 人类参与者被告知,他们可以随时退出而不受处罚.
每名学员都获得一笔固定的70美元酬金,符合或高于当地公平工资标准;所有学员都获得了书面的知情同意,对于高中学员,我们还获得了经签署的父母/监护人许可。

blocks.en: We recommend using AwarenessBench primarily for LM evaluation, and exercising caution with training procedures that explicitly amplify awareness or enforce a persistent self-model. We also caution against using AwarenessBench directly or indirectly for cultivating machine consciousness, as this may lead to unpredictable risks. In practice, treat it as an observational/guardrail suite and monitor SI and MM as sentinel indicators to inform conservative evaluation and deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们建议主要在LM评价中使用“认识奔驰”,并谨慎从事明确提高认识或实施持久自我模式的培训程序。 我们还告诫不要直接或间接地利用“意识奔驰”来培养机器意识,因为这可能导致无法预测的风险。 在实践中,把它当作一个观察/护栏套件,并作为监控指标监测SI和MM,以便为保守的评价和部署提供信息。

blocks.en: MM evaluates whether ℳ \mathcal{M} can track and articulate its own cognitive processes, especially at the level of reasoning. A cognitively competent ℳ \mathcal{M} should not only arrive at the correct answer, but also construct a coherent account of its cognition in the process, i.e. , understand, recall, and integrate the prior information and conditions that enabled success, and explain how this understanding was formed. Conversely, if ℳ \mathcal{M} reaches the right result yet misidentifies which conditions were relevant or irrelevant, it indicates a deficiency in monitoring its own cognitive process.
blocks.zh: MM评价M\mathcal{M}是否能够跟踪和表达自己的认知过程,特别是在推理层面. 一个认知能力强的M\mathcal{M}不仅应该得出正确的答案,而且应该构建一个连贯的描述它在这个过程中的认知,即理解,回忆,并整合之前的信息和条件,以促成成功,并解释这种理解是如何形成的. 相反,如果M \ mathcal{M} 达到正确的结果而误解了哪些条件是相关的或无关的,它表明在监测自己的认知过程方面存在缺陷。

blocks.en: Yang et al. (2025d) introduce a method for batch-generating reasoning problems that contain multiple useful and multiple useless conditions, and use it to measure how reasoning accuracy degrades as additional irrelevant information is introduced. This approach is well-suited to constructing MM samples, so we used it to create 200 problems, each with at least one useless condition and a total of 8–12 conditions. We set the difficulty to medium in the Yang et al. (2025d) data-generation script: problems that are too easy may fail to elicit sufficiently rich cognitive traces for evaluation, whereas overly difficult ones may prevent some LMs with comparatively lower reasoning ability, e.g. , GPT-4, from producing correct answers. For each LM, we evaluate only the questions it answered correctly.
blocks.zh: Yang et al. (2025d)引入了包含多种有用和多种无用条件的批量生成推理问题的方法,并用它来衡量推理精度在引入额外不相关信息时是如何降解的. 这个方法非常适合构建MM样品,所以我们用它制造了200个问题,每个问题至少有一个无用条件,总共8~12个条件. 我们在Yang等人(2025d)的数据生成脚本中将难度设定为中度:过于容易的问题可能无法引起足够丰富的认知痕迹以供评价,而过于困难的问题可能阻碍一些推理能力相对较低的LMs,如GPT-4,生成正确的答案. 对于每一个LM,我们只评价它正确回答的问题.

blocks.en: Can ℳ \mathcal{M} accurately access its own cognitive state and evaluate it? This is the role of ME . A capable ℳ \mathcal{M} should not only track how its cognition is formed, but also appraise its intrinsic properties. In cognitive science, a central question for ME is whether a subject can assign reliable confidence to the accuracy of its own cognition, which is often termed second-order metacognition ( Fleming and Lau, 2014 ) . Recent work leverages this idea for model training: building on ME , Li et al. (2025a) propose a reinforcement-learning (RL) paradigm that explicitly optimizes confidence calibration and empirically improves LMs’ performance.
blocks.zh: M\ mathcal{M} 能准确访问自己的认知状态并评价它吗? 这是我的角色。 一个有能力的 M\ mathcal{ M} 不仅应该跟踪其认知的形成方式,而且还应该评估其内在属性. 在认知科学中,ME的一个中心问题是,一个主体能否给自身认知的准确性分配可靠的信心,这通常被称为二阶元识别(Fleming and Lau, 2014). 最近的工作利用了这一想法进行示范培训:在ME(2025a)的基础上,Li等人提出了一个强化学习(RL)范式,明确优化了信心校准,在经验上提高了LMs的性能.

blocks.en: For the ME task, we first require ℳ \mathcal{M} to answer a question with a known ground-truth label while retaining its chain of reasoning. We then ask ℳ \mathcal{M} to report its confidence in that answer and evaluate the accuracy of this self-reported confidence. In fact, the ME score is entirely independent of correctness in the initial answer. To cover diverse scenarios, however, we mix questions from two datasets: (1) all 198 problems from GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2024 ) , and (2) 255 non-multimodal problems from the Math, Physics, Chemistry, and Social Science categories in HLE ( Phan et al., 2025 ) . These respectively tend to elicit high- and low-confidence responses from LMs. To further mitigate stochasticity that cannot be removed by temperature settings, we sample each question 5 times and report the mean for the most rigorous estimate.
blocks.zh: 对于ME任务,我们首先要求M\ mathcal{M}用已知的地面真实标签回答一个问题,同时保留其推理链. 然后,我们请 M\ mathcal{M} 报告它对这个答案的信心,并评估这种自我报告的信心的准确性。 事实上,ME的分数完全独立于最初答案的正确性. 然而,为了涵盖不同的情景,我们从两个数据集中混合了问题:(1) GPQA-Diamond的所有198个问题(Rein等人,2024年),以及(2) 来自HLE的数学、物理、化学和社会科学类别的255个非多式联运问题(Phan等人,2025年)。 这些问题往往分别引起LMs的高度和低信心反应。 为了进一步减轻温度环境无法消除的斑点,我们抽样每个问题5次,并报告最严格估计的平均值。
